costNote: Making the drugs. It fell to $4.29B from $5.30B a year ago — last year's quarter carried heavier charges — which is a big reason profit jumped.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Commercial teams behind the drug launches, plus head-office costs.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Clinical trials and the pipeline — AbbVie also closed the Apogee Therapeutics acquisition this quarter.

opex.name: Acquired IPR&D, milestones & other
opex.note: $216M paid for acquired in-process research and milestone payments, net of $18M of other operating income. A year ago this line was $2.68B — the main reason GAAP EPS more than doubled.

otherDetail.label: Interest expense, net
otherDetail.note: The cost of AbbVie's debt, net of interest earned.

otherDetail.label: Other expense, net
otherDetail.note: Mostly investment and foreign-exchange losses below the operating line.

footerNote: Net income is the consolidated $4,220M; $4,218M was attributable to AbbVie after noncontrolling interests.

oneTimers.label: Acquired IPR&D & milestones
oneTimers.text: $216M of expense ($0.11 per share) for bought-in research and milestone payments — lumpy by nature, and far below the $2.68B that hit the same quarter last year.

segments.name: Immunology
segments.note: Skyrizi $5.78B (+23%) and Rinvoq $2.71B (+24%) now dwarf Humira, down 31% to $683M as biosimilars keep eating it. The portfolio grew 16%.

segments.name: Neuroscience
segments.note: Botox Therapeutic $1.08B, Vraylar $1.07B, migraine drugs Ubrelvy + Qulipta $847M, and Vyalev $286M. Up 19%.

segments.name: Eye care & other
segments.note: Everything AbbVie doesn't break out as a headline portfolio — mainly eye-care products. Computed as the remainder of total revenue.

segments.name: Oncology
segments.note: Venclexta $803M, Imbruvica $522M (shrinking under competition) and Elahere $224M. Roughly flat, up 0.8%.

segments.name: Aesthetics
segments.note: Botox Cosmetic $669M and the Juvederm filler family $222M. Down 1.4% in a soft consumer-spending environment.

sources.label: AbbVie Q3 2026 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Oct 30, 2026)

takeaways.text: The two successor drugs brought in $8.48B — nearly half of all revenue — growing about 23–24% each, more than replacing Humira's decline.
takeaways.title: Skyrizi + Rinvoq carry the company

takeaways.text: A year ago, $2.68B of acquired IPR&D and milestone charges crushed GAAP profit to $0.10 a share. This year's charge was $216M, so GAAP EPS jumped to $2.37.
takeaways.title: GAAP EPS more than doubled

takeaways.text: AbbVie raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $13.95–13.99 and announced a 5.2% dividend increase starting with the February 2027 payment.
takeaways.title: Dividend raised for 2027

verdict: The post-Humira growth engine is firing: Skyrizi and Rinvoq drove revenue up 10% and GAAP profit surged as last year's deal charges faded.
